description.value: Ay Chihuahua is a Mexican restaurant located in Tsawwassen, BC. It offers indoor seating in what appears to be a casual dining setting suited to a quick meal stop on a ride. As a local Mexican spot in the Tsawwassen community, it provides a hearty cuisine option for cyclists passing through or arriving via the nearby BC Ferries terminal.
